message:
Lately, I've been reflecting on the simple joys of life and how much we can rediscover when we step away from our screens. Planning for emergencies might not sound like fun, but it can be quite an adventure! I found a wonderful resource that helps you create a family emergency plan—something that can bring us all together. 

It's a great way to spark conversations and maybe even a little bit of creativity around the dinner table. Who knows? It might just turn into a beloved family tradition. What’s your favorite way to prepare together?
